suggestions.title: Scope project-tagged observed quota failures in router decisions
suggestions.rationale: The Quota And Routing UAT plan expects project-tagged observed quota failures to block the same project without suppressing unrelated projects. Current production behavior records the project_id but AgentClassRouter queries IQuotaFailureStore.GetMostRecentAsync without a project argument, so a project-tagged failure currently trips the global observed-failure gate for the same agent/model across all projects. The UAT suite now covers the current behavior; implementing project-aware router lookups would close the divergence.
